grouping_resolution.note: Screening grouping retained for verification; source-specific attribution remains explicit.

artifact.canonical_name: LLM Agents Are Latent Context Managers: Eliciting Self-Managed Context via State Proprioception

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30005v5
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The authors propose VISTA, a training-free layer that makes agent context state explicitly visible and manageable.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.target: verify VISTA design and benchmark results
targets.finding: VISTA exposes token usage, recency, archive state, and remaining context budget to the agent through typed addressable blocks, and is evaluated on LOCA-Bench, BrowseComp-Plus, and GAIA.

editorial.why_now_note: This June paper is technically valid but is retained as supporting/Paper Watch material unless Candidate Selection has room.
editorial.rationale: Primary-paper evidence is valid but lower priority than stronger June themes.
